scene: The workbench shuts down safely, revealing transit bays along the yard.
picture: Flat side view on a level concrete floor. A South Asian girl with a long black braid in a teal hoodie sits in a purple wheelchair at centre beside a quiet bench. On the far left, a glass elevator stands open. On the left sits a waiting steam train. On the right, a brass airship floats.
shown: A transparent glass elevator shaft on the far left with open doors waiting.
A puffy steam train stopped at a low platform on the left.
A tethered brass airship waiting beside an open gangway on the right.
